prior_data: All V1/V2 train/dev/test are development or regression data only; never claim them as new independent V3 test.

UTKinect.selection: All recorded RGB frames in walk official interval plus 30 frame prefix/suffix, and continuous sitDown-through-standUp interval plus 30 frame prefix/suffix. Preserve original frame IDs / 30 as timestamps; do not invent missing source observations.
UTKinect.labels: Official walk/sitDown/standUp timestamps; other intervals unknown unless independently visually annotated before model test. pickUp is not silently relabeled bending.

Weizmann.viewpoint: Official robust_view archive could not be acquired; excluded before training/testing. View diversity comes from UTKinect frontal/oblique and existing HADE/URFD plus Weizmann side-view sources. No claim of angle-disjoint testing.

URFD_new.labels: Official falling state0, lying state1/background; state-1 unknown five-class and negative binary fall.

model_selection: Fit on train only, use subject-disjoint dev plus historical regression sources for model selection. Choose configurations before any new test predictions. Freeze artifact, manifest and inference source hashes before new test evaluation.
regression_constraints: Prefer candidates improving standing_up, walking and bending on development while preserving V2 falling decisions and not increasing seated false rising. Frozen V2 fall branch may be retained explicitly; report routing/ablation, do not describe this as a single new end-to-end network.
test_metrics: per-class precision recall F1 including unknown
official fall windows and event overlap, delay
provisional static seated false-rise and unknown
limitations: UTKinect and Weizmann test actors are disjoint by provided identity names within each dataset, but room/camera is shared. URFD subject identities not established. Some seated boundaries require provisional visual annotation. Small public staged data is not broad deployment validation.
acquisition_amendment_before_training: 2026-10-18: official Weizmann host repeatedly returns empty response. Use named-original-AVI Kaggle mirror wendguan/weizmann for walk and bend, preserve predeclared subject split; record original archive hash unavailable.
